title: Need 10 Screen-Free Minutes Tonight? Hold a Secret Meeting
description: A simple family reset: draw a TALK, IMAGINE or DO card, take turns, then choose one tiny Earth mission. The 16-card Gaia’s Secret Agents Founding Pack is A$5, printable at home and made for curious kids ages 6–11. Instant download.
alt_text: Gaia’s Secret Agents Secret Meeting Cards Founding Pack, a 16-card printable family activity for screen-free conversation, imagination and one small Earth action.
